## Q13
```{r}
# Read the file directly from the URL
url <- "https://bioboot.github.io/bggn213_W19/class-material/rs8067378_ENSG00000172057.6.txt"
data <- read.table(url)

# Inspect the first few rows to make sure it looks right
head(data)
```

```{r}
# 1. Sample Size for each genotype
cat("Sample Size for each genotype:\n")
table(data$geno)

# 2. Median Expression for each genotype
cat("Median Expression for each genotype:\n")
tapply(data$exp, data$geno, median)
```

## Q14
```{r}
# Boxplot of Expression by Genotype
boxplot(exp ~ geno, data = data,
        main = "Expression of ORMDL3 by Genotype",
        xlab = "Genotype (rs8067378)",
        ylab = "Expression Level (FPKM)",
        col = c("red", "green", "blue"),
        notch = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Perform One-Way ANOVA
# Formula: Expression depends on Genotype (exp ~ geno)
results_aov <- aov(exp ~ geno, data = data)

# Print the summary (Look for the "Pr(>F)" column, which is your P-value)
summary(results_aov)
```
